  min-height: 120px;

  box-shadow: none;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk > div {
  flex-grow: 1
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk .ot-sdk-row {
  display: flex;
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: auto;
  padding-left: 30px;
  padding-right: 30px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 1239px) {
  #onetrust-banner-sdk .ot-sdk-row {
    max-width: 1080px;
  }
}

  max-width: 650px;

}

  margin-bottom: 0;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text,
#onetrust-banner-sdk .ot-dpd-desc,
#onetrust-banner-sdk .ot-b-addl-desc {
  color: #000000;
  font-family: Interstate,"Lucida Grande","Lucida Sans Unicode","Lucida Sans",Garuda,Verdana,Tahoma,sans-serif;
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk:not(.ot-iab-2).vertical-align-content #onetrust-button-group-parent {
  position: static;
  transform: none;
  margin-left: 20px;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk.ot-buttons-fw:not(.ot-iab-2) #onetrust-button-group,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-button-group {

}

  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin: auto;
  max-width: 45%;
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
  position: static;
  transform: none;
  width: unset;
}

        </style><link rel="prefetch" href="/blog/page-data/index/page-data.json"><link rel="prefetch" href="/blog/page-data/index/page-data.json"></head><body class=""><noscript id="gatsby-noscript">This app works best with JavaScript enabled.</noscript><div id="___gatsby"><div style="outline:none" tabindex="-1" role="group" id="gatsby-focus-wrapper"><nav class="navigation"><a class="navigation__item navigation__home" href="/blog/"></a><div class="navigation__links"><a href="https://developers.soundcloud.com" class="navigation__item">Developers</a><a class="navigation__item navigation__item--active" href="/blog/">Blog</a><a href="https://soundcloud.com/you/apps" class="navigation__item">Your Apps</a><a href="https://soundcloud.com/jobs" class="navigation__item">Jobs</a></div></nav><div class="layout__container "><h1 class="blogPost__title">Moving to Modern Streaming: Introducing AAC HLS on SoundCloud APIs [Deadline Extended]</h1><p class="blogPost__metadata">September 15th, 2025<!-- --> <!-- -->by <span>Youssef Hassan</span></p><div class="blogPost__content"><p>At SoundCloud, we’re always looking for ways to improve the listening experience for our creators, partners, and listeners. One of the biggest improvements we can make is at the very core: the audio streams themselves.
Over the years, our API has returned a set of streaming URLs based on MP3 and Opus formats. While these formats served us well, it’s time to modernize. To provide higher quality, more consistent playback, and better support across devices, we’re moving to AAC-based HLS streams.</p>
<h2>🚀 What’s changing?</h2>
<p>Starting today, the streams endpoint (/tracks/{track_urn}/streams) includes new HLS AAC transcodings:</p>
<ul>
<li>hls_aac_160_url (standard quality, preferred format and bitrate)</li>
<li>hls_aac_96_url (alternative quality, depending on availability and can work as fallback to the 160k stream)</li>
</ul>
<p>For a transition period, existing fields like http_mp3_128_url, hls_mp3_128_url, and hls_opus_64_url will remain available.</p>
<h2>⏳ Deadline Extended: Deprecation Timeline</h2>
<p>We plan to remove Progressive HTTP, HLS MP3 and HLS Opus transcodings from our APIs on December 31, 2025.
The following fields will no longer be supported after that date:</p>
<ul>
<li>http_mp3_128_url (Progressive HTTP MP3) </li>
<li>hls_mp3_128_url (HLS MP3)</li>
<li>hls_opus_64_url (HLS Opus)</li>
</ul>
<p>preview_mp3_128_url will remain available for preview use cases.</p>
<h2>✅ What you need to do</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Migrate from MP3 / Opus to AAC</p>
<ul>
<li>Replace http_mp3_128_url, hls_mp3_128_url, and hls_opus_64_url with the new AAC HLS streams.</li>
<li>Use hls_aac_160_url (preferred) or hls_aac_96_url where available.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Migrate from Progressive HTTP to HLS</p>
<ul>
<li>Progressive MP3 playback (http_mp3_128_url) will no longer be supported.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Test your integration with the new URLs to ensure a smooth migration.</p>
<h3>🔍 Example Response as of now</h3>
<div class="gatsby-highlight" data-language="text"><pre class="language-text"><code class="language-text">{
"http_mp3_128_url": "https://cf-media.sndcdn.com/trackid.128.mp3?...",
"hls_mp3_128_url": "https://cf-hls-media.sndcdn.com/playlist/trackid.128.mp3/playlist.m3u8?...",
"hls_aac_160_url": "https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_160k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...",
"hls_opus_64_url": "https://cf-hls-opus-media.sndcdn.com/playlist/uuid.64.opus/playlist.m3u8?...",
"preview_mp3_128_url": "https://cf-preview-media.sndcdn.com/preview/0/30/trackid.128.mp3?..."
}</code></pre></div>
<h3>🔍 Example Response after Dec 31, 2025</h3>
<div class="gatsby-highlight" data-language="text"><pre class="language-text"><code class="language-text">{
"hls_aac_160_url": "https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_160k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...",
"hls_aac_96_url": "https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_96k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...",
"preview_mp3_128_url": "https://cf-preview-media.sndcdn.com/preview/0/30/trackid.128.mp3?..."
}</code></pre></div>
<h2>💬 Feedback</h2>
<p>We’d love to hear how the transition works for you. If you run into issues or need additional support, please open <a href="https://github.com/soundcloud/api/issues">a discussion on GitHub</a>.
This change sets the foundation for better audio quality and playback reliability across SoundCloud integrations. We encourage you to migrate early and share your feedback.</p></div><aside class="blogPost__categories"><ul class="categories"><li class="categories__category"><a class="categories__categoryLink"
